entries.text: Those damn Radscorpions have been after our Brahmin since we moved here.# Not a week goes by that someone doesn't get poisoned trying to keep them out of the# pens. Last week they took my brother Jarvis. Razlo, our doctor, is looking for an# antidote as quickly as he can. Hey, if you have the means to help us, why don't# you talk to our leader, Aradesh.
entries.source_text:
Those damn Radscorpions have been after our Brahmin since we moved here.
# Not a week goes by that someone doesn't get poisoned trying to keep them out of the
# pens. Last week they took my brother Jarvis. Razlo, our doctor, is looking for an
# antidote as quickly as he can. Hey, if you have the means to help us, why don't
# you talk to our leader, Aradesh.

entries.text: There are several groups of raiders. I organize guards like Ian# to help fight them off. There is one band to the southeast of here. Watch out for them.
entries.source_text:
There are several groups of raiders. I organize guards like Ian
# to help fight them off. There is one band to the southeast of here. Watch out for them.

entries.text: Shady Sands is a peaceful community. We have our own irrigation# system, so we can grow our own food. If we were not plagued# with raiders and Radscorpions, we would have no problems.
entries.source_text:
Shady Sands is a peaceful community. We have our own irrigation

entries.source_text: 你看见赛思，沙荫镇的门卫队长。

entries.text: 你！你在这小镇惹的麻烦已经够多的了，我现在要亲手杀了你。
entries.source_text: 你！你在这小镇惹的麻烦已经够多的了，我现在要亲手杀了你。

entries.text: 我看你来者不善良。我会杀了你，从此又一个混蛋要从这废土上消失了。

entries.text: 我看你没那么聪明，呃？好吧，小心那些大蝎子，别惹麻烦。

entries.text: 那些可恶的大蝎子自我们搬到这来不久就出现了，那些没有被大蝎子蛰过人的都尽量远离它们。上周，我的兄弟贾维斯中了蝎子的毒，如果你有什么方法能帮我们的话，为什么不去和我们的镇长亚拉德什谈谈呢？
entries.source_text: 那些可恶的大蝎子自我们搬到这来不久就出现了，那些没有被大蝎子蛰过人的都尽量远离它们。上周，我的兄弟贾维斯中了蝎子的毒，如果你有什么方法能帮我们的话，为什么不去和我们的镇长亚拉德什谈谈呢？

entries.text: 那儿有好多歹徒，我组织了一些象伊恩那样的警卫和他们战斗。那些歹徒在南方有一个基地，你可要小心。

entries.text: 沙荫镇是个宁静的地方，我们有自己的灌溉，能自己提供食物如果不是因为那些大蝎子和歹徒的骚扰，我们就不会有那么多麻烦。

entries.text: 我们全镇的人都向你表示感谢，谢谢你帮我们除掉了蝎子。谢谢！

entries.text: 你可以去和亚拉德什谈谈，我们的镇长。他非常欢迎任何来访者，他应该在镇政厅，南面的那幢建筑。
